desc: Derive the impartial-game characterization and prove which sorted-value/parity condition determines the winner.
Analyze duplicate values carefully, especially how equal adjacent values affect available winning moves.
Use exact small-state minimax/retrograde analysis to discover and reject candidate outcome rules.
Validate the derived rule against the provided examples and small manually enumerated games.
Produce a concise Python implementation that reads stdin and prints `Fennec` or `Snuke`.
Check edge cases including \(N=1\), all values equal, strictly increasing values, and very large values.
